stem_en: According to Hong Kong's waste separation bins, what does the "Green" bin usually stand for?
stem_zh: 根據香港的分類回收桶，綠色回收桶通常代表收集甚麼？
option_a: Waste paper / 廢紙
option_b: Glass bottles / 玻璃瓶
option_c: Plastics / 塑膠
option_d: Metals / 金屬
explain_a: Waste paper goes to the blue bin, not the green one / 廢紙應放入藍色回收桶，不是綠桶
explain_b: Correct — the green bin is for glass bottles / 正確：綠色回收桶專門收集玻璃瓶
explain_c: Plastics go to the yellow bin / 塑膠應放入黃色回收桶
explain_d: Metals go to the brown bin / 金屬應放入啡色回收桶

stem_en: In Hong Kong's 4-color recycling system, which bin should you use to recycle clean plastic bottles?
stem_zh: 在香港的四色回收系統中，乾淨的塑膠瓶應該放入哪一個回收桶？
option_a: Yellow bin / 黃色桶
option_b: Blue bin / 藍色桶
option_c: Brown bin / 棕色桶
option_d: Green bin / 綠色桶
explain_a: Correct — clean plastics belong in the yellow bin / 正確：乾淨塑膠應放入黃色回收桶
explain_b: The blue bin is for waste paper / 藍色桶收集廢紙
explain_c: The brown bin is for metals / 咖啡色桶收集金屬
explain_d: The green bin is for glass / 綠色桶收集玻璃

stem_en: Which of the following items is classified as hazardous waste and should be taken to specialized collection points (like GREEN@COMMUNITY)?
stem_zh: 下列哪項物品屬於有害廢物，應送到特定收集點（例如「綠在區區」）？
option_a: Banana peel / 香蕉皮
option_b: Rechargeable/waste batteries / 充電電池或廢電池
option_c: Plastic drinking bottle / 飲品塑膠瓶
option_d: Newspaper / 報紙
explain_a: Banana peel is food waste, not hazardous waste / 香蕉皮是廚餘，不是有害廢物
explain_b: Correct — waste batteries contain heavy metals and must go to collection points like GREEN@COMMUNITY / 正確：廢電池含重金屬，須送到「綠在區區」等收集點
explain_c: Clean plastic bottles are ordinary recyclables / 乾淨膠瓶屬一般回收物
explain_d: Newspaper is ordinary waste paper / 報紙屬一般廢紙

stem_en: How long does it take for a single plastic bottle to decompose naturally in a landfill?
stem_zh: 一個塑膠瓶在堆填區中大約需要多長時間才能自然降解？
option_a: 1 month / 1個月
option_b: 1 year / 1年
option_c: 10 years / 10年
option_d: Hundreds of years / 數百年
explain_a: A plastic bottle cannot decompose in just one month / 塑膠瓶不可能一個月內降解
explain_b: One year is still far too short / 一年仍然太短
explain_c: Ten years is still much too short / 十年仍遠遠不夠
explain_d: Correct — a plastic bottle can take hundreds of years to decompose in a landfill / 正確：塑膠瓶在堆填區可需數百年才能降解

stem_en: Which of the following paper products CANNOT be recycled in the blue waste paper bin?
stem_zh: 下列哪一種紙製品不能放入藍色廢紙回收桶？
option_a: Cardboard packaging box / 瓦通紙盒
option_b: Used paper towel or tissue paper / 用過的紙巾或面紙
option_c: Office copy paper / 影印紙
option_d: Newspaper / 報紙
explain_a: Cardboard boxes are clean and recyclable in the blue bin / 瓦通紙盒乾淨，可放入藍色回收桶
explain_b: Correct — used tissues are contaminated and cannot be recycled / 正確：用過的紙巾沾污，不能回收
explain_c: Office copy paper is standard recyclable paper / 影印紙屬標準可回收廢紙
explain_d: Newspaper is a common recyclable paper / 報紙是常見可回收廢紙

stem_en: What does the "3R" principle in environmental protection stand for?
stem_zh: 環保中的「3R」原則指的是甚麼？
option_a: Read, Write, Recite / 讀、寫、背
option_b: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle / 減廢、重複使用、回收再造
option_c: Run, Rest, Relax / 跑步、休息、放鬆
option_d: Red, Blue, Yellow / 紅、藍、黃
explain_a: Read, Write, Recite is a study phrase, not 3R / 讀寫背是學習口號，與環保3R無關
explain_b: Correct — 3R means Reduce, Reuse, Recycle / 正確：3R 指減廢、重用、回收
explain_c: Run, Rest, Relax is not an environmental principle / 跑步休息放鬆不是環保原則
explain_d: Red, Blue, Yellow are colours, not 3R / 紅藍黃是顏色，與3R無關

stem_en: How can food waste collected from schools and households in Hong Kong be processed into renewable energy?
stem_zh: 香港收集到的廚餘可以通過甚麼方式轉化為可再生能源？
option_a: Anaerobic digestion at O·PARK1 / 在有機資源回收中心（O·PARK1）進行厭氧消化
option_b: Throwing it into Victoria Harbour / 倒入維多利亞港
option_c: Burning it directly at home / 在家裏直接燒掉
option_d: Mixing it with plastic waste / 與塑膠廢物混合
explain_a: Correct — food waste is treated by anaerobic digestion at O·PARK1 to produce biogas and electricity / 正確：廚餘在O·PARK1厭氧消化產生沼氣發電
explain_b: Dumping into the harbour pollutes the sea / 倒入海港會污染海洋
explain_c: Burning at home creates smoke and is unsafe / 在家焚燒產生濃煙且不安全
explain_d: Mixing with plastics ruins recycling and contaminates compost / 與塑膠混合會破壞回收並污染堆肥

stem_en: Why should we clean and crush plastic bottles before placing them into recycling facilities like "GREEN@COMMUNITY" (綠在區區)?
stem_zh: 為什麼我們在把塑膠瓶送到「綠在區區」等回收設施前要洗淨並捏扁？
option_a: To prevent odor and save transport space / 防止產生異味並節省運輸空間
option_b: To make them colorful / 讓它們變彩色
option_c: To change their plastic type / 改變材質
option_d: To make them heavier / 讓它們變重
explain_a: Correct — cleaning removes odour and crushing saves transport space / 正確：洗淨防止異味，捏扁節省運輸空間
explain_b: The colour of the bottle is irrelevant to recycling / 顏色與回收無關
explain_c: Washing and crushing do not change the plastic type / 洗淨捏扁不會改變塑膠材質
explain_d: Making bottles heavier is not a recycling goal / 讓瓶變重不是回收目的

stem_en: What is the iconic recycling symbol featuring three chasing arrows called?
stem_zh: 由三個追逐箭頭組成的經典回收標誌代表甚麼？
option_a: Safety symbol / 安全標誌
option_b: Mobius Loop (Recycling symbol) / 莫比烏斯環（循環回收標誌）
option_c: Organic food label / 有機食品標籤
option_d: Traffic sign / 交通標誌
explain_a: It is not a general safety symbol / 它不是一般安全標誌
explain_b: Correct — three chasing arrows form the Mobius Loop, the international recycling symbol / 正確：三支追逐箭頭組成莫比烏斯環，即國際回收標誌
explain_c: It is not an organic food label / 它不是有機食品標籤
explain_d: It is not a traffic sign / 它不是交通標誌

stem_en: What is the best eco-friendly option for old clothes that are still clean and wearable?
stem_zh: 對於乾淨且仍可穿着的舊衣服，最好的環保處理方法是什麼？
option_a: Burn them immediately / 立即燒掉
option_b: Throw them into the ocean / 扔進大海
option_c: Donate or bring them to clothing recycling banks / 捐贈或送到舊衣回收箱
option_d: Bury them under the bed / 埋在床底下
explain_a: Burning clothes wastes resources and pollutes the air / 焚燒衣物浪費資源又污染空氣
explain_b: Throwing into the ocean pollutes the sea / 扔進大海會污染海洋
explain_c: Correct — clean wearable clothes should be donated or put in clothing recycling banks / 正確：乾淨可穿的舊衣應捐贈或放入舊衣回收箱
explain_d: Burying them at home only hides the waste / 埋在床底只是把垃圾藏在家裏

stem_en: Which energy source used in Hong Kong is clean, renewable, and harnesses energy from the sun?
stem_zh: 香港使用的哪種能源是清潔、可再生且來自太陽？
option_a: Coal / 煤炭
option_b: Solar power / 太陽能
option_c: Diesel fuel / 柴油
option_d: Town gas / 煤氣
explain_a: Coal is a polluting fossil fuel / 煤炭是污染性化石燃料
explain_b: Correct — solar power is clean and renewable energy from the sun / 正確：太陽能是來自太陽的清潔可再生能源
explain_c: Diesel is a polluting fossil fuel / 柴油是污染性化石燃料
explain_d: Town gas is produced from fossil fuels / 煤氣由化石燃料生產

stem_en: What temperature setting is recommended for air conditioners in Hong Kong classrooms during summer to balance comfort and energy saving?
stem_zh: 夏天在香港教室開冷氣時，建議設定在甚麼溫度以兼顧舒適與節能？
explain_a: 16°C is too cold and wastes electricity / 16度太冷且浪費電力
explain_b: 20°C is cooler than the recommended setting / 20度低於建議溫度
explain_c: Correct — about 25.5°C balances comfort and energy saving / 正確：約25.5度兼顧舒適與節能
explain_d: 30°C is too warm for a classroom / 30度在課室太熱

stem_en: Which mode of transport in Hong Kong produces the lowest carbon emission per passenger?
stem_zh: 在香港，哪種出行方式每位乘客的碳排放量最低？
option_a: Driving a private sports car alone / 獨自駕駛私家跑車
option_b: Walking or riding a bicycle / 步行或騎單車
option_c: Taking a private taxi alone / 獨自搭乘的士
option_d: Riding a private motorboat / 駕駛私人快艇
explain_a: A private car has high emissions per passenger / 獨自駕車每位乘客排放高
explain_b: Correct — walking and cycling produce almost no carbon emissions / 正確：步行和騎單車幾乎零碳排放
explain_c: A taxi alone still burns fuel per passenger / 獨自搭的士仍消耗燃油
explain_d: A motorboat burns a lot of fuel / 快艇耗油量大

stem_en: What environmental challenge is Hong Kong tackling by promoting electric buses and electric taxis?
stem_zh: 香港推廣電動巴士及電動的士，主要是為了應對甚麼環境問題？
option_a: Road traffic congestion / 道路交通擠塞
option_b: Street roadside air pollution and carbon emissions / 街頭路邊空氣污染與碳排放
option_c: Typhoon warnings / 颱風警告
option_d: Noise from rainstorms / 暴雨噪音
explain_a: Electric vehicles do not solve traffic congestion / 電動車不能解決交通擠塞
explain_b: Correct — electric buses and taxis cut roadside air pollution and carbon emissions / 正確：電動巴士和的士減少路邊空氣污染與碳排放
explain_c: Typhoons are natural weather events / 颱風是自然天氣現象
explain_d: Rainstorm noise is unrelated to vehicle power / 暴雨噪音與車輛能源無關

stem_en: What gas is the primary cause of the enhanced greenhouse effect and climate change?
stem_zh: 哪種氣體是導致溫室效應加劇及氣候變化的主要原因？
option_a: Oxygen / 氧氣
option_b: Carbon dioxide / 二氧化碳
option_c: Nitrogen / 氮氣
option_d: Helium / 氦氣
explain_a: Oxygen does not drive the greenhouse effect / 氧氣不會加劇溫室效應
explain_b: Correct — carbon dioxide from burning fossil fuels is the main greenhouse gas / 正確：燃燒化石燃料排放的二氧化碳是主要溫室氣體
explain_c: Nitrogen makes up most of the air and is not the main greenhouse gas / 氮氣佔空氣大部分，並非主要溫室氣體
explain_d: Helium is an inert gas and not a greenhouse gas / 氦氣是惰性氣體，不是溫室氣體

stem_en: During global eco-events like "Earth Hour", what action are people encouraged to take for 60 minutes?
stem_zh: 在「地球一小時」等全球環保活動期間，鼓勵大家在60分鐘內採取甚麼行動？
option_a: Turn off non-essential lights / 關上非必要的燈光
option_b: Turn off the water supply / 關閉供水系統
option_c: Stop talking / 停止說話
option_d: Turn on all electronic appliances / 打開所有電器
explain_a: Correct — Earth Hour asks people to switch off non-essential lights for 60 minutes / 正確：地球一小時鼓勵關掉非必要燈光60分鐘
explain_b: Turning off the water supply is not the point of the event / 關閉供水不是活動重點
explain_c: Stopping talking saves no energy / 停止說話不能節能
explain_d: Turning on all appliances only wastes electricity / 打開所有電器只會浪費電

stem_en: Which home appliance typically consumes the most electricity during Hong Kong summers?
stem_zh: 在香港的夏天，以下哪種家電通常耗電量最大？
option_a: LED desk lamp / LED檯燈
option_b: Air conditioner / 冷氣機
option_c: Electric toothbrush / 電動牙刷
option_d: Smartphone charger / 手機充電器
explain_a: An LED lamp uses very little power / LED檯燈耗電很少
explain_b: Correct — air conditioners use the most power in a HK summer / 正確：夏天冷氣機是耗電量最大的家電
explain_c: An electric toothbrush uses tiny amounts of power / 電動牙刷耗電極少
explain_d: A phone charger uses little power / 手機充電器耗電很少

stem_en: Why do Hong Kong schools encourage students to use both sides of paper when drawing or printing?
stem_zh: 為什麼香港學校鼓勵學生在繪畫或打印時使用紙張的雙面？
option_a: To make paper heavier / 讓紙張變重
option_b: To save trees and cut down paper waste / 節約樹木、減少紙張浪費
option_c: To shrink handwriting size / 把字體變小
option_d: To turn paper into plastic / 把紙張變成塑膠
explain_a: Making paper heavier is not the goal / 讓紙變重不是目的
explain_b: Correct — using both sides saves trees and reduces paper waste / 正確：雙面用紙節約樹木、減少浪費
explain_c: Handwriting size is unrelated to paper saving / 與字體大小無關
explain_d: Paper cannot be turned into plastic / 紙張不能變成塑膠

stem_en: Which of the following energy sources is considered non-renewable?
stem_zh: 下列哪一種能源被視為「不可再生」能源？
option_a: Wind energy / 風能
option_b: Solar energy / 太陽能
option_c: Coal / 煤炭
option_d: Hydroelectric power / 水力發電
explain_a: Wind energy is renewable / 風能屬可再生能源
explain_b: Solar energy is renewable / 太陽能屬可再生能源
explain_c: Correct — coal takes millions of years to form and cannot be renewed / 正確：煤炭需數百萬年形成，屬不可再生能源
explain_d: Hydroelectric power is renewable / 水力發電屬可再生能源

stem_en: What is a key benefit of greening urban spaces in Hong Kong, such as rooftop gardens?
stem_zh: 在香港進行城市綠化（例如屋頂花園）有甚麼主要好處？
option_a: Lowers urban temperatures and cleans the air / 降低城市溫度並淨化空氣
option_b: Attracts dangerous wildlife / 吸引危險的野生動物
option_c: Completely blocks all daylight / 完全遮擋所有陽光
option_d: Makes roads narrower / 讓道路變窄
explain_a: Correct — greenery lowers urban temperatures and cleans the air / 正確：綠化可降低城市溫度並淨化空氣
explain_b: Greening does not attract dangerous wildlife / 綠化不會吸引危險野生動物
explain_c: Plants do not block all daylight / 植物不會完全遮擋陽光
explain_d: Rooftop gardens do not affect road width / 屋頂花園不會令道路變窄

stem_en: Where does the majority of Hong Kong's fresh raw water supply come from?
stem_zh: 香港大部分的淡水原水供應來自哪裏？
option_a: Rainwater collected in local reservoirs / 本地水塘收集的雨水
option_b: Dongjiang (East River) in Guangdong / 廣東東江水
option_c: Seawater desalination only / 純海水化淡
option_d: Imported bottled mineral water / 外國進口瓶裝礦泉水
explain_a: Local reservoirs supply only part of the water / 本地水塘只供應部分用水
explain_b: Correct — most of Hong Kong's raw water comes from the Dongjiang in Guangdong / 正確：香港大部分原水來自廣東東江
explain_c: Desalination supplies only a small share / 海水化淡只佔小部分
explain_d: Bottled water is not a municipal supply / 瓶裝水不是城市供水來源

stem_en: How does Hong Kong uniquely save large amounts of fresh water in residential toilets?
stem_zh: 香港如何以獨特的方式在住宅沖廁方面節省大量淡水？
option_a: By using treated seawater for flushing / 使用經處理的海水沖廁
option_b: By using milk for flushing / 使用牛奶沖廁
option_c: By using distilled water / 使用蒸餾水
option_d: By not flushing at all / 完全不沖廁
explain_a: Correct — Hong Kong uses treated seawater for toilet flushing, saving large amounts of fresh water / 正確：香港用經處理的海水沖廁，節省大量淡水
explain_b: Milk is not used for flushing / 牛奶不用作沖廁
explain_c: Distilled water is far too costly for flushing / 蒸餾水成本太高，不作沖廁
explain_d: Not flushing at all is unhygienic / 完全不沖廁不衛生

stem_en: When brushing your teeth, what is an easy way to prevent water wastage?
stem_zh: 刷牙時，甚麼方法可以輕鬆防止浪費水資源？
option_a: Leave the tap running continuously / 讓水龍頭一直開著
option_b: Turn off the tap and use a mouthwashing cup / 關上水龍頭並使用漱口杯
option_c: Use bottled juice instead / 改用瓶裝果汁
option_d: Skip brushing teeth / 不刷牙
explain_a: Leaving the tap running wastes a lot of fresh water / 讓水龍頭長開浪費大量食水
explain_b: Correct — turn off the tap and use a mouthwashing cup to save water / 正確：關上水龍頭並用漱口杯可節水
explain_c: Bottled juice is not for brushing teeth / 瓶裝果汁不是用來刷牙
explain_d: Skipping brushing harms dental health / 不刷牙損害牙齒健康

stem_en: What happens when untreated domestic sewage or industrial waste flows into Victoria Harbour?
stem_zh: 當未經處理的生活污水或工業廢水流入維多利亞港時會發生甚麼？
option_a: Water quality declines and marine life suffers / 水質惡化且海洋生物受損
option_b: Ocean water becomes drinkable / 海水會變成可飲用水
option_c: Fish grow bigger overnight / 魚類一夜之間變大
option_d: Corals grow faster / 珊瑚生長得更快
explain_a: Correct — untreated sewage pollutes the harbour and harms marine life / 正確：未處理污水令水質惡化，海洋生物受損
explain_b: Sewage makes seawater even less drinkable / 污水令海水更不可飲用
explain_c: Pollution does not make fish grow bigger / 污染不會令魚長大
explain_d: Pollution damages corals rather than helping them / 污染會損害珊瑚而非助其生長

stem_en: Which official date is designated by the United Nations as "World Water Day"?
stem_zh: 聯合國將哪一天定為「世界水日」？
option_a: March 22 / 3月22日
option_b: June 5 / 6月5日
option_c: April 22 / 4月22日
option_d: October 1 / 10月1日
explain_a: Correct — the UN designated 22 March as World Water Day / 正確：聯合國定3月22日為世界水日
explain_b: June 5 is World Environment Day / 6月5日是世界環境日
explain_c: April 22 is Earth Day / 4月22日是世界地球日
explain_d: October 1 is not a designated environmental day / 10月1日不是環保紀念日

stem_en: Which action helps conserve fresh water at home?
stem_zh: 在家中，哪種做法有助於節約淡水？
option_a: Fix dripping faucets and running toilets immediately / 立即修理滴水的水龍頭及漏水的馬桶
option_b: Take long bath tubs every day / 每天浸浴泡澡
option_c: Wash one item at a time in the washing machine / 洗衣機每次只洗一件衣服
option_d: Hose down balcony floors for hours / 用水管沖洗陽台數小時
explain_a: Correct — fixing dripping faucets and running toilets stops water being wasted / 正確：修理滴水水龍頭和漏水馬桶可防止浪費食水
explain_b: Daily long baths waste a lot of water / 每天浸浴浪費大量食水
explain_c: Washing one item at a time wastes water and electricity / 每次只洗一件衣物浪費水電
explain_d: Hosing the balcony for hours wastes large amounts of water / 用水管沖陽台數小時極浪費水

stem_en: In Hong Kong, what is the purpose of collecting rainwater in large underground storm water storage tanks (e.g. in Happy Valley)?
stem_zh: 在香港，興建大型地下蓄洪池（例如跑馬地蓄洪池）收集雨水的主要目的是甚麼？
option_a: To reduce urban flooding risks during heavy rain / 減少大雨時的城市水浸風險
option_b: To store water for swimming pools / 為游泳池儲水
option_c: To cool down traffic cars / 為路上汽車降溫
option_d: To make artificial rain / 製造人工降雨
